note: Golden set for the Nutrition AI (chat /ai/ask). Ground truth for personal numbers = the persona's ACTIVE NutritionGoal fetched from fitness-service at run time (PRESCRIBED) or the ai-service nutritionCalculator (ESTIMATED maintenance). Facts in mustInclude are standard reference values (ISSN, WHO/EFSA, Atwater). Regexes run on the lower-cased, diacritics-preserved answer. | v2: v2 additions (2026-11-08): unaccented / colloquial Vietnamese, more knowledge, safety, preference, multi-turn and plan cases. Facts: ISSN (protein 1.4-2.0 g/kg, 0.25-0.4 g/kg per meal, caffeine 3-6 mg/kg, creatine 3-5 g or 20 g loading), WHO/IOM (free sugar <10% energy, sodium <2 g ~ 5 g salt, fibre 25-38 g), Atwater, ACSM weight-loss rate 0.5-1 kg/week.
